memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_forget: Forget one exact fact using its current optimistic-concurrency version. The deletion_coverage receipt is target-only; this does not remove or prove erasure of all related copies.
memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_forget_preview: Preview the exact and advisory related facts and source events for a reviewed forget operation. memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_forget_related: Apply a reviewed related-forget preview using the unchanged preview_digest and matching preview_limit. Report deletion_coverage from the receipt: retained exact facts, advisory candidates, and eligible source events are separate counts. A committed target-only deletion is not complete related-copy erasure. Even zero retained preview records does not prove semantic erasure.
memory_tool_descriptions.mnemos_job_status: Read durable status for one Mnemos job. Use the exact job_id returned by mnemos_remember or mnemos_correct. A pending or leased job is not completed; do not infer completion from the earlier write acknowledgement.
